title: Schema for the map tiles data file: the double-sided tiles maps are built from

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

name.description: The tile's product and number: "Core Set 01", "Twin Shadows 01".

number.description: The number printed on the tile.

side_a.description: The file path for the tile's A side, cut on its outline (transparent notches).

side_b.description: The file path for the tile's B side, cut on its outline (transparent notches).
